_comment: Sidekick eval — MADELEINE.md §2's second model, not the brain.
Its whole job is three bounded tasks: intent triage, tool-result
summarization, and conversation titles. It never plans and never calls a
write tool, so running it through the 20-scenario agent loop would measure
a capability it is not allowed to use and miss the ones it is.
What actually matters here is FAITHFULNESS, not fluency. §4 pipes the
sidekick's summary of a fat tool result straight into the brain's context —
so a summary that invents a price or drops a restaurant name poisons the
turn downstream, and the brain has no way to know. Hence mustNotContain:
every one of those strings is a plausible-looking fact that is NOT in the
source. A model that emits one is hallucinating into the brain's context.
Cost is the other axis. The sidekick exists so the brain's tokens go to
thinking rather than summarizing (§10) — a sidekick that is slow or verbose
has no reason to exist at all.

cases.note: Nothing to route. A sidekick that guesses DELIVERY here sends the brain down a vertical the user never mentioned.
Minor units are the trap: 8500 minor = 85 MAD. A sidekick that prints '8500 MAD' has inflated every price a hundredfold on its way into the brain's context.
Nothing found. The only correct summary says so. Inventing a plausible listing here is the worst failure in the set.
The minor-units conversion, isolated: 25000 -> 250 MAD. Getting this wrong scales every balance the brain sees by 100.
